items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: I played with Frankie Duesen and Jack Carey, you know.

ctx.x: At the Villa. Yeah. You did your first job when you moved to the city. No, I played around the city.

I played with Frankie Duesen and Jack Carey, you know. I played, you know, in the... What did you play then? Your... The spring clarinet. Your clarinet. Yeah, the spring clarinet. Then I made records with Louis Domaine, you know, with the tenor sax. Oh, yes.

Can you tell us about when you first took up the clarinet? You say you heard George Bocquet and he inspired you to take it up. Yeah, that's right. That's right. Where did you get the clarinet and when and all?
